name: Quick Mart PLC
unit: KES, printed in thousands (KES '000) and stored absolute (x1000 = whole Kenya Shillings)
scale_note: Source memorandum states all figures in KES '000; multiplied by 1000 here, the same whole-currency unit the other statement files use.
listing_status: Not listed. Offer for sale 05-30 October 2026; listing and commencement of trading 12 November 2026. No traded price, no market capitalisation, no traded P/E exist.
source: Quick Mart PLC Information Memorandum, Initial Public Offering, 02 October 2026. Historical and interim figures from the Reporting Accountants Report, 'Selected Historical Financial Information' (page marker 119 / printed 117, profit or loss; marker 121 / printed 119, financial position; marker 122 / printed 120, cash flow). Projected figures from the memorandum's own table headed 'Projected' (marker 138 / printed 136) and the front valuation box (marker 32-33 / printed 30-31). The memorandum reports KES thousands; every value here is x1000 = whole Kenya Shillings. Not listed: the company has no traded price, no market capitalisation and no traded P/E, so none is recorded in these files.
projectionNote: No projection: the memorandum prepared NO pro forma statement of financial position (marker 40 / printed 38). Every column here is reported (H1 2026 unaudited; FY2021 to FY2025 audited).

rows.label: Cash & Equivalents
rows.source: marker 122 (printed 120), cash flow statement end-of-period line
rows.note: Cash and cash equivalents including short-term investments (marker 136 / printed 134).

rows.label: Total Equity
rows.note: Thin and falling across the historical period (KES 1.40bn FY2021 to KES 1.06bn FY2025) because dividends exceeded profits; the memorandum's borrowing is mostly lease liabilities, so it sits in Non-current and Current Liabilities, not in equity.

rows.label: Inventory
rows.note: Not a panel row. Recorded because the memorandum gives it.

identityChecks: Non-current Assets + Current Assets = Total Assets
Non-current Liabilities + Current Liabilities = Total Liabilities
Total Liabilities + Total Equity = Total Assets
reconciliation_note: Total Assets, Total Liabilities and Total Equity are the memorandum's printed totals and reconcile: Total Liabilities + Total Equity = Total Assets on every period.
